_comment: Example Claude Code settings.json wiring plan-gate as a PreToolUse hook. Replace the absolute paths with your own (no ~ or $HOME here). The env block turns the gate on, points it at your plans directory and sets the audit log directory; the hooks block runs the gate before every gated tool call. Use python3 (a bare python is missing on many systems) and an absolute script path: a hook command that cannot start does not block anything. Verify the gate is live after wiring it (see plan-gate/README.md). PLAN_GATE_ALWAYS_WRITABLE below makes the plans directory writable by the agent, so an agent can write an active plan itself; remove it if a human should write plans. The matcher does not include MCP tools; add mcp__.* to route them to the gate.
